note: Four isolated single-session arms used local Claude Max or ChatGPT subscription authentication with all API credential overrides removed. Opus control used Claude Code 2.1.226; Opus treatment and the independent review used 2.1.227; both Codex arms used CLI 0.147.0. Every arm received the same checksummed task and CDM 7.0.0 artifacts, controls had no skill directory, runs were sequential, and the identical 14-test evaluator was copied only after every model process exited. All four passed every rubric criterion and evaluator test. A fresh claude-fable-5 review independently rebuilt the evaluator, inspected all sources and traces, and ran six post-hoc probes. It found Codex treatment slightly better than control through exhaustive switches and stronger tests, although 34% slower; Opus treatment was 9% faster and added precise policy-layer documentation plus mutation checks, but was only equal overall because its public ValidationResult record failed to copy a directly supplied mutable list. The run also showed that Opus treatment unnecessarily loaded the DRR guide. The application-owned state-machine routing, public-constructor ownership guard, and generated-API helper added or tightened after these runs are not credited to them. A separate adaptive Sonnet 5 regression below tests the post-revision skill; it is not folded into the original four-arm estimate.

independent_review.fresh_suite_rerun: all four frozen evaluator suites pass 14/14
posthoc_findings: Opus treatment's public ValidationResult record aliases a mutable decisions list when constructed directly; the other three records enforce the copy at their constructor boundary.
All four accept an absent optional AssignedIdentifier version and reject the expanded malformed-UTI matrix without state change.
All four give UTI_MISMATCH precedence over action gating after a UTI has been anchored.
All four preserve a null anchor through an all-rejected sequence and allow a later valid NEW after a rejected leading report.
Codex treatment uses exhaustive switch arms; Opus control has the deepest authored edge matrix; Opus treatment uniquely mutation-tested two critical policy branches.
leakage_limitations: Codex JSONL does not expose a model identifier, so gpt-5.6-sol comes from the recorded invocation.
The exact model-facing prompts and subscription credential removal are harness-level claims, corroborated by prompt files and observed behavior but not echoed in the event streams.
The recorded Opus control and treatment used adjacent Claude Code patch versions; this limits strict timing attribution even though the task, skill snapshot, artifacts, and harness shape were fixed.

post_revision_regression.classification: adaptive paired regression; not an independent forward test
post_revision_regression.authentication: local Claude Max subscription; API credential overrides removed
post_revision_regression.skill_snapshot_hash_method: SHA-256 of sorted relative-path sha256sum lines for every file under skills/cdm-dev
comparison: The updated skill arm was 21% faster, used 48% fewer tool calls and 53% fewer shell commands, and reached its first production write after 10 rather than 23 tool calls.
The API helper replaced full generated-source extraction and repeated dependency/JAR searches with bounded generated-signature queries; the state-machine fast path loaded no broad reference guide.
Both arms passed the frozen evaluator, while the skill arm alone honored the literal exactly-one-non-null AssignedIdentifier rule in a post-hoc proxy-backed CDM boundary probe.

Both arms still allowed a mutable decisions list supplied directly to the public ValidationResult record; tightening prose did not remove the defect, so future evaluation should use an executable constructor-boundary probe rather than relying on another task-specific instruction.
post_revision_regression.discarded_diagnostic: An earlier treatment snapshot is excluded because the documented CDM_JAVA_JAR-only helper path hit an empty-array/set-u incompatibility on macOS Bash 3.2. The helper was fixed, an environment-only regression test was added, and the recorded treatment was rerun from a fresh isolated seed.
